title: FTyShiftRow
html:
定义组：System F 语法。有序参数：z1823、z1824、z1825。

类型指标提升；进入全称类型时 cutoff+1。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ FTyShiftRow z1823 z1824 z1825) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists c
  (exists k
    (exists t
      (exists u
        (and
          (exists z1828
            (and (exists z1829 (and (@ Pair t u z1829) (@ Pair k z1829 z1828))) (@ Pair c z1828 z1825)))
          (and
            (@ Nat c)
            (and
              (@ Nat k)
              (and
                (@ PolyTyAny t)
                (and
                  (@ PolyTyAny u)
                  (or
                    (exists z1830
                      (and
                        (@ FTV z1830 t)
                        (or
                          (and (in z1830 c) (= t u))
                          (exists z1831 (and (or (= z1830 c) (in c z1830)) (and (@ Add z1830 k z1831) (@ FTV z1831 u)))))))
                    (or
                      (exists z1832
                        (exists z1833
                          (exists z1834
                            (exists z1835
                            (and
                            (@ TArr z1832 z1833 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TArr z1834 z1835 u)
                            (and
                            (exists z1837
                            (exists z1838
                            (and
                            (in z1837 z1824)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1823 z1837 z1838)
                            (exists z1839
                            (and (exists z1840 (and (@ Pair z1832 z1834 z1840) (@ Pair k z1840 z1839))) (@ Pair c z1839 z1838)))))))
                            (exists z1841
                            (exists z1842
                            (and
                            (in z1841 z1824)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1823 z1841 z1842)
                            (exists z1843
                            (and (exists z1844 (and (@ Pair z1833 z1835 z1844) (@ Pair k z1844 z1843))) (@ Pair c z1843 z1842))))))))))))))
                      (exists z1832
                        (exists z1833
                          (exists z1836
                            (and
                            (@ FForall z1832 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FForall z1833 u)
                            (and
                            (@ Succ c z1836)
                            (exists z1845
                            (exists z1846
                            (and
                            (in z1845 z1824)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1823 z1845 z1846)
                            (exists z1847
                            (and (exists z1848 (and (@ Pair z1832 z1833 z1848) (@ Pair k z1848 z1847))) (@ Pair z1836 z1847 z1846))))))))))))))))))))))))

直接依赖

Add；App；FForall；FTV；Nat；Pair；PolyTyAny；Succ；TArr
